lyrics:
[Intro: staccato orchestral string stabs, handclaps, deep bass]
Go on, go on, it's your half birthday
Six months in and it's your day anyway
We don't need a reason, we don't need a date
Pull a candle out the drawer, let's celebrate

[Verse 1: laid-back male rap, melodic drawl]
I got a cake in the car and it's leaning to the left
Frosting on the seat belt, nothing I regret
Stopped for balloons and they only had two
One says "Get Well" and the other one's blue
Called up your people and they're coming in their slippers
Your neighbour brought a casserole, your uncle brought the kippers
No one knows the reason and nobody's keeping score
We're just glad you made it halfway, so we're knocking on the door

[Chorus: sung drawl, claps on every beat]
Go on, go on, it's your half birthday
Six months in and it's your day anyway
We don't need a reason, we don't need a date
Pull a candle out the drawer, let's celebrate

[Verse 2: laid-back male rap, a little quieter]
See, a year's too long to wait to say you're doing fine
I've lost a couple friends who thought they had the time
So I'm ringing every bell on every ordinary Tuesday
If you woke up this morning then it's good news day
Half a glass, half a chance, half a life to go
Half of what we worry on, we'll never even know
So blow out the one candle, make half a wish
And I'll be back in six months with another dish

[Chorus: sung drawl, claps on every beat]
Go on, go on, it's your half birthday
Six months in and it's your day anyway
We don't need a reason, we don't need a date
Pull a candle out the drawer, let's celebrate

[Bridge: strings drop out, bass and claps, crowd sings along]
Halfway there (halfway there)
And you're still right here (still right here)
Halfway there (halfway there)
See you next half year

[Final Chorus: full beat, crowd, ad-libs]
Go on, go on, it's your half birthday
Six months in and it's your day anyway
We don't need a reason, we don't need a date
Pull a candle out the drawer, let's celebrate

Make a wish
Half a wish
